description: Cloudaware Service Graph connects ChatGPT to a live inventory of the organization's infrastructure: every resource across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, Kubernetes, VMware and Nutanix, with its configuration, configuration history, cost, vulnerabilities, and the monitoring and security agents installed on it. Cloudaware discovers it through the providers' APIs and the systems already in place, keeps it current as resources change, and maps each resource to the application it serves. With the connector enabled, ChatGPT answers questions about inventory, configuration, changes, security coverage and cost across every cloud and data center from a single source. The connector is read-only and replaces a separate integration for every cloud and tool, so a single answer can draw on all of them.

defaultPrompt: Show me publicly accessible instances with IP addresses across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Provide a summary of spending across Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Microsoft Copilot.
Generate a report of instances across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premises that have not been scanned for vulnerabilities.
